items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: Pat Foster and I was in the band.

ctx.x: Do you remember anything about Jazzland, what it was like? Did you ever go there and sit in?

Well, yes. I went there and sit in with the band one night. Turpin had given a macaroni dinner for the Bullock band. And we went on out there. And the guys in the band, at least a piano player in the band, he was rated as the best blues player in St. Louis. I just remember his name. I think his name was John something. And the Russian racket just came out. It was kind of a tough number. So what he done was Pat Foster and I was in the band. Dodge was sitting in the band. And he called Indian Blues. It must have…
Oh yeah, that's a tough precaution.
